title: The Barn

services.name: Adult Sewing Class
services.desc: Take some time for yourself, in the company of others, at our Beautiful Barn in Mariemont, Ohio. The entire second story, a stunning space we call the the Loft, becomes a Sewing Studio - a place where you'll learn, decompress and just enjoy yourself. You don't need to know anything, or bring anything. Just show up, pick from our beautiful fabrics and learn from our experienced, fun instructors who love sharing this skill, with others. We provide everything: Machines, fabrics, patterns and every tool/gizmo you'll need to make something you love. No pressure or pre-planning on your part. Just join us! We've got you taken care of the minute you walk in the door. And we always have coffee

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Nestled within the quaint walls of The Barn, our summer camps for kids offer a delightful blend of creativity and craftsmanship. Housed in a charming old space that exudes rustic charm, these camps provide an ideal setting for young minds to explore various artistic pursuits. Guided by skilled instructors, campers not only master the art of sewing but also can sign up for other creative endeavors such as painting and wood crafts. Each day unfolds with a new learning moment or fresh project, fostering a sense of accomplishment and igniting a passion for hands-on creativity. services.desc: Please join us and adorable baby goats (and a toy poodle!) from Yogoat Cincinnati for guided Goat Yoga @ The Barn! For all friends and family 10+. Only paid registrants will be admitted, though participation in the yoga flow is optional. Please bring a yoga mat or beach towel. Portable, leak-proof water bottles allowed; food and open beverage containers are not. NOTE: All participants must sign a Waiver of Liability to Participate upon arrival.
